title: Code and data for "Temporal Supervision Horizon and Latent-Dynamics Recovery in SIR Universal Differential Equations"
description:
Reproducible companion to the article: the SIR-UDE library in Julia, the runners for the eleven experiments, the result files behind every value cited in the manuscript, the scripts that generate the six figures, and four checkers that recompute each cited value from the delivered data and report whether it matches.

The verification runs on the Python standard library alone, with no Julia and no third-party packages, so the cited values can be checked in seconds without installing anything. Reproducing the experiments themselves requires Julia and takes hours to days.
